declaration.reason: The shared SignaturePlatform.jsx change is covered by the open cross-portal component repair window. The current repair combines the already authorised Signature Self-Test session-safety fix with a Signature Portal-only invitation delivery diagnostics panel. The panel adds per-signer SMTP evidence and owner-controlled copy/share actions; all seven portal smoke checks remain mandatory because the component is shared.
declaration.expectedEffect: The Signature Self-Test cannot follow Gateway authentication redirects into an interactive login gateway. Signature invitation messages use signer/position-specific multipart MIME and unique Message-ID; SMTP stage replies and automatic hand-off outcomes are recorded and visible to the envelope owner. Copy and WhatsApp actions use the same signer-specific link returned after the existing resend flow accepts the email. All other portal workflows and the signing protocol remain unchanged.

activeAmendment.expectedEffect: The existing order-group invitation rules remain unchanged: signers in the first eligible position receive invitations together; later positions are released only when all earlier-position signers have signed. The repair records explicit hand-off started/sent/failed events and the SMTP reply evidence for each delivery. Each email invitation uses a signer/position-specific subject and multipart MIME with a unique Message-ID. Copy and WhatsApp actions use the existing resend flow and the exact link returned only after SMTP acceptance. No signing order, token or session semantics change.

declarationNote: The previously reported case was described as parallel/non-hierarchical. The repair preserves the existing same-position parallel invitation group and configured order-group rules; it adds delivery evidence and hand-off events without converting the envelope to sequential signing.
